suggestions.topic: Hegota non-headliner EIP proposal deadline and initial triage
suggestions.rationale: Deadline was August 6 (2 days from now per #241). Teams need to confirm final submissions and begin initial discussion of newly proposed EIPs that weren't presented in #238-242.

suggestions.topic: Platåberget testnet launch decision and repricing finalization
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #242 deferred launch timing to 'next week's ACDT' and blocked on repricing numbers. EL teams had deadline of 'early next week' (now) to finalize benchmarks. This is a blocker for the public testnet.

suggestions.topic: Resolve Hive chain PR #1589 blocking issue (EIP-7928 BAL disagreement)
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #242 flagged clients disagreeing on EIP-7928 BAL contents at block 57, blocking Hive test infrastructure. This is a spec interpretation blocker for Glamsterdam.
Once repricing is finalized, need confirmation on ENR field support (all clients currently missing per #242) and discv5-only mode readiness for devnet-8 launch.

Deferred from ACDE #239 (June 18) due to presenter absence. Expected revisit was 'next call' but hasn't been presented in #240-242. If still targeting Hegota, should present before proposal window closes.

suggestions.topic: Glamsterdam EIP status promotion to SFI and Review
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #241-242 noted seven EIPs pending author approval to move to Review status, and SFI promotion blocked on testing team confirmation of four milestones. This affects meta EIP-7773 progression.

suggestions.topic: CL non-engine methods on engine port cleanup discussion
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #241 raised issue of unnecessary methods (eth_getBlockByNumber, eth_chainId, etc.) on engine port and dead eth1 deposit path code. Teams were asked to review but no follow-up in #242.

suggestions.topic: glamsterdam-devnet-7 stability report and next steps
suggestions.rationale: ACDE #242 reported 100% participation and stable operation. Brief status check before transitioning focus to devnet-8/Platåberget makes sense for continuity.
